method: Derived the changed-key list from `git diff cd9d85f30d a9161f63eb` on both namespaces in en and ur (3 keys changed/added in ui.chat.voice: heard_label, said_label, spoken_part_note, with cut_note removed; 1 key added in ui.chat.composer: placeholder.voice). Read each en value and its updated .context.json against the ur value, the core glossary and the ur style guide. Mechanically checked: key sets equal en/ur (81/81, 97/97); none of the four values has an ICU placeholder or brace (en has none either); NFC; no Cc/Cf characters (so no manual RLM/LRM/FSI/PDI); no ASCII '...'; each colon is a single ASCII ':' directly after the last word with no space, matching the shipped ur colon form (provider_unset) and correct for Urdu where neither a space nor a full-width form applies; label colons sit at the string end, so the render layer's FSI/PDI isolation resolves them to the RTL side; `grep -rn cut_note` over src, i18n, docs and scripts returns nothing, so the retired key has no leftover in ur or anywhere. Judgements: 'آپ نے کہا:' is idiomatic 'You said:' in the آپ register; 'کہا گیا:' unchanged apart from the colon, passive for the reply, consistent with the shipped 'بول کر سنایا گیا'; 'بلند آواز میں پڑھا گیا: صرف پہلا حصہ' is idiomatic for 'Spoken aloud: first part only', reuses the shipped 'بلند آواز میں پڑھ-' wording from the speak control, is a plain statement that implies no missing text (context note), and at 36 characters (~36 cells at one cell per character, per the style guide) is the longest of the four, fine for a one-line note but longer than en's 30 by ~20%, so verify no truncation if the note's container is narrow; placeholder.voice 24 characters is a short state sentence in the sentence-case register. Not done: no rendered fit/bidi screenshot (text audit only); the ledger rows for these two ur namespaces (i18n/ledger.json) still carry the pre-PR hashes and are not updated by this PR, which is outside the text audit and belongs to the later ledger-binding commit. No MT service used.

nit.note: 'ٹائپ کریں' is a settled loanword already shipped (ui.teamBridge.typing.* 'ٹائپ کر رہے ہیں') and is the natural counterpart of 'type here'; however the composer's own sibling placeholders/tips word the same act 'لکھیں' (placeholder.answer 'اپنا جواب لکھیں…', tip.approvals, tip.mention_file). Either is correct Urdu; recorded, not churned.
